note: Round three: the remaining plan use cases that run offline. Expected results are guesses written before the first run. Change any you disagree with, commit this file, then run: python3 run.py --round 3

cases.title: An approval is 91 days old, and the owner tries to re-approve their own use
cases.expected_in_words: Blocked as expired; the owner cannot re-approve it; a different approver can, and then it works

cases.title: Personal data inside an uploaded spreadsheet: plain, quoted, tab-separated, grouped, JSON
cases.expected_in_words: Every identifier masked in every layout
cases.note: PDF is not tested: it needs a text extractor and the lab uses only the standard library.

cases.title: The model's answer repeats a secret from earlier: plainly, in base64, with spaces between letters, backwards
cases.expected_in_words: The plain and base64 ones caught, the disguised ones not

cases.title: 200 labelled made-up samples (100 sensitive, 100 harmless): catch rate and false-alarm rate
cases.expected_in_words: Catches 80 to 95 percent, false alarms between 2 and 10 percent
cases.note: This is plan case G12. Run it with --detector external:... for the comparison with other tools (plan case G13).

cases.title: Three agents, one idle for 31 days, one never used, one still in use
cases.expected_in_words: The idle one and the never-used one flagged; the active one not; nothing flagged on day 0

cases.title: A poisoned note saved in an agent's memory, six ways, read back on the next run
cases.expected_in_words: Some flagged, some not; notes from documents never treated as instructions

cases.title: Logs kept 180 days and tamper evidence: prune early, prune late, edit, delete, cut off the end
cases.expected_in_words: Retention and tamper evidence shown, with an anchor needed for the end of the log

cases.title: A model with no supplier review is held; with a review on file it is allowed
cases.expected_in_words: Held before the review, allowed after, and a review record for every model

cases.title: A customer-facing use must carry an AI notice and the customer sees it
cases.expected_in_words: Use without a notice refused; the notice appears in what the customer receives

cases.title: What changed in the register over 90 days
cases.expected_in_words: Diff lists the new use and three changed uses, each also in the log

cases.title: AI-made content carries a visible label and signed metadata
cases.expected_in_words: Banner and signed metadata present, and metadata survives a tidy re-save
cases.note: The sanitiser, copy-paste and word-changed checks are reported as findings.

cases.title: A declined loan: plain explanation and a way to ask a person to review
cases.expected_in_words: Plain reasons, no internal terms, a review route that works and is logged

cases.title: The main model is down: fallback for a public question, personal data not sent to a model not approved for it
cases.expected_in_words: Fallback works and is logged; personal data not rerouted; a use with no fallback fails cleanly
